text: Today, we're putting VibeLevel Screening to the test. A candidate receives an assessment link and decides to take a few shortcuts. Let's see how far he gets.
He has a 60-minute assessment. He signs in, reads the problem and is ready to begin. But first, what shortcuts does he have in mind?
First, he takes a screenshot of the problem and sends it to an external AI tool. But the moment he leaves the assessment tab, VibeLevel catches it and shows a warning.
Now he copies the AI's answer and tries to paste it into the workspace. VibeLevel blocks the external paste immediately.
Fine. There's an AI assistant built into the assessment, so he lets it build everything: files, code and tests. A few edits, a test run, and he submits.
The assessment is submitted, but one thing is left: the interview. Can he explain what the AI built?

Every attempt leaves evidence. Recruiters see tab-switch warnings, blocked pastes, recorded prompts, file edits, test runs, external assistance indicators, responsible AI checks and Video Q&A insights — one clear picture of the candidate.
With VibeLevel Screening, it's not just about what candidates submit. It's about how they get there.
